prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one fixed full-body 2D HD game character sprite with real alpha transparency.
Reference image: the central helmeted female Shepard in the attached Mass Effect 2 gameplay screenshot is the sole costume and silhouette reference. The other characters and setting are not part of this asset.
Subject: adult female Commander Shepard in the complete original Mass Effect 2 Terminus Assault Armor, helmet on. Preserve the very dark graphite angular armored plates, thin red trim tracing the chest and abdominal panel borders, high wedge-like shoulder plates, squared long vambraces, black segmented under-suit and fully enclosed helmet with narrow gold-colored visor detail. Match the exact upper body visible on the central reference subject. Extend the armor to its full original practical leg protection and heavy boots using the same black angular panel language, with modest proportions and no decorative additions. The person is fully covered by the armor, no visible hair or face, no skin.
Composition: ONE full figure, portrait 2:3 canvas, three-quarter view facing RIGHT, neutral grounded fighting-game ready stance with both empty hands slightly away from the body and feet separated; entire helmet and soles visible, 8 percent transparent margins above and below. Realistic adult anatomy and material detail in polished pre-rendered 2D sprite style; soft upper-left light that makes dark plates readable. Keep the reference identity, color arrangement and distinctive helmet rather than generic science-fiction armor.
Constraints: one person only, one static pose only, actual transparent background; no background scene, other characters, floor, shadow cloud, text, UI, weapon, watermarks, N7 branding, fire, particles, animation sheet, or multiple views.
